source: TU Dortmund Whistle Detection Dataset, TestBench folder (Kleingarn and Braemer 2024, doi:10.17877/tudodata-2024-m0f6bmi1, CC BY-SA 4.0). Recordings made on a NAO V6 robot at RoboCup; 4 channels, 22050 Hz.
how: Whistle start times marked by eye on spectrogram pictures (0 to 7 kHz, 45 s per picture) by our AI coding assistant on 15 Nov 2026, about 0.3 s precise. 'unsure' are faint marks that might or might not be whistles; detections there count neither way. These are hand labels on other recordings, which the competition rules allow.
